info.name: Jenosize AI CRM
info.description:
API collection for the Jenosize AI CRM MVP.

## Base URL
All requests use `{{baseUrl}}`. Switch between local and tunnel by selecting an environment (top-right in Postman):
- **Jenosize CRM — Local** → http://localhost:3000
- **Jenosize CRM — Tunnel** → your current `*.trycloudflare.com` URL (paste it in after each `pnpm tunnel` run)

If no environment is selected, the collection falls back to http://localhost:3000.

## Auth
Call **Auth / Login** first. It sets the HttpOnly `crm_session` cookie, which Postman's cookie jar stores per-domain and sends automatically on every later request to the same base URL. Log in once per base URL (localhost and the tunnel are different domains, so each needs its own login).

## LINE webhook signature
The LINE webhook verifies an HMAC-SHA256 (`X-Line-Signature`). Set the `lineChannelSecret` collection variable to your channel secret (`LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET` in .env). The signed requests compute the header automatically in a pre-request script from the exact request body.

exec: // crm_session cookie is stored automatically in Postman's cookie jar.

request.description:
Simulates an inbound LINE text message with a valid signature. The pre-request script computes `x-line-signature` from `lineChannelSecret` over the exact body.

- First send → `processed: 1` (persists a Message(RECEIVED) + LINE_IN activity, if `lineUserId` maps to a Contact).
- Re-send unchanged → `duplicate: 1` (idempotent on webhookEventId).
- If `lineUserId` is not linked to any Contact → `unmapped: 1` (stored as a signed FAILED audit row).

`lineUserId` defaults to a seeded LINE contact. Change `lineWebhookEventId` + `lineMessageId` to process a new event.
Sends a deliberately bad `x-line-signature`. Expected: 401 `blocked`; the body is NOT parsed or stored as a message — only safe audit metadata (body hash + signature-present flag) is recorded.
Clears the `crm_session` cookie. Placed last so a full 'Run collection' logs out only after the other requests have used the session.
